## v1.43.0

The direct Salesforce tools now keep every value in the request body, so `mgmt.doctor` no longer warns about them. A tool you already added keeps its old request until you add it again. See Behavior change.

### Changed

- `salesforceLeadUpsert` and `salesforceContactUpsert` call Salesforce's sObject Collections upsert (`PATCH .../composite/sobjects/<Object>/<key field>`). The upsert key and every other value go in the JSON body, never in the URL. (#510)
- The Lead and Contact tools map `result` (the record id) and `success`. The default description tells the agent to say a record is saved only when `success` is `true`, and never to treat an empty result as saved. (#510)
- `externalIdField` must be a Salesforce field API name (letters, digits and underscores). Anything else throws a `TypeError`. (#510)

### Fixed

- `mgmt.doctor` no longer reports `api_tool_url_arg_unsafe` for the direct Salesforce tools. (#510)

### Behavior change

- Salesforce refuses a record with HTTP 200 and `success: false`, not an error status. Examples are a missing required field, an invalid email, or two Leads with the same email. The agent now gets that result and can say it could not save. Before, it saw only a generic error line. (#510)
- A refused update can still return the id of the record it matched. Rely on `success`, never on the id. (#510)
- A tool added with an earlier version keeps its old request. Add it again with the new builder to get the new request. (#510)

### Docs and skill

- `docs/EXTERNAL-API-INTEGRATIONS.md` lists the Lead and Contact defaults, what the agent can say for each Salesforce answer, the duplicate-email case, and access-token options. (#510)
- `scripts/live-verify-salesforce-lead.mjs` and `scripts/live-verify-salesforce-agent.mjs` check both tools against a Salesforce Developer Edition org. `scripts/README.md` describes them. (#510)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.42.0...v1.43.0
